bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; appropriating money for violent crime enforcement teams.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$3,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of public safety for violent crime enforcement teams. This is a onetime appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; appropriating money for violent crime enforcement teams.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

$3,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of public safety for violent crime enforcement teams. This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: $3,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of public safety for violent crime enforcement teams. This is a onetime appropriation.
